arguments.message:
Hi there! Meridian does support payment by wire (bank) transfer, but only for annual contracts that are billed via invoice. This isn’t a self‑service option you’ll see on the pricing or checkout pages – you’ll need to work with our support team to set up invoiced billing before the contract starts. Once the account is configured for invoiced billing, we can issue an invoice that you can pay by wire transfer.

If you’d like to arrange this, just let us know and we’ll get the billing team set up for you.
